common_rules.visibility_invariant: A bar is visible at decision_time if and only if is_closed is the exact JSON boolean true; source_timestamp, close_time, available_at, and decision_time are present, valid, timezone-aware, mutually comparable timestamps; and source_timestamp <= decision_time, close_time <= decision_time, and available_at <= decision_time. Any missing, malformed, incomparable timestamp or pseudo-boolean is_closed fails closed to DATA_INVALID and UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
common_rules.event_visibility_invariant: An event is visible at decision_time if and only if source_timestamp, published_at, available_at, and decision_time are present, valid, timezone-aware, mutually comparable timestamps; and source_timestamp <= decision_time, published_at <= decision_time, and available_at <= decision_time. source_timestamp records source provenance and is distinct from published_at, the public event publication time. Any missing, malformed, incomparable or future timestamp fails closed to DATA_INVALID and UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN.
common_rules.availability: Every field must be point-in-time available. Bar fields require the full visibility_invariant; source_sequence is comparable only within the same source_id and generation_id_or_stream_id. Cross-source equal-available-at batch has no economic order.
common_rules.record_identity_rule: Missing, duplicate or conflicting identity fails closed. Different generation/stream sequences are incomparable; stable_input_id is canonical replay only and has no economic ordering meaning.
common_rules.required_tfstate_quality: Every required TFState must have DataQuality=VALID. STALE, GAP, CONFLICT, DATA_INVALID or UNKNOWN forces UNKNOWN_OR_ABSTAIN and cannot produce EVALUATE_REVERSAL or EXECUTION_READY.
common_rules.parent_child_gate_priority: Parent-child CONFLICT/UNKNOWN blocks only new EVALUATE_REVERSAL/EXECUTION_READY and never suppresses higher-priority HALT/EXIT/MANAGE_ONLY.
common_rules.comparison: One predeclared independent comparison edge per hypothesis on the same opportunity universe, time split, cost, latency and fill assumptions.
common_rules.coverage: Insufficient eligible episodes produces INCONCLUSIVE_COVERAGE, never a relaxed threshold.
common_rules.calibration: Probability-bearing hypotheses require Brier, log loss, calibration slope/intercept and reliability-bin reporting.
common_rules.post_fill_scoring: Immutable five-branch submission prediction; P(fill), joint terminal and filled-cohort scores each report their own denominator/count. DataDisposition never rewrites prediction or fabricates labels.
common_rules.execution: OHLC-only barrier ambiguity resolves STOP_FIRST and cannot claim a limit fill.
common_rules.promotion: No result automatically mutates v0.2.2, v0.3, active G1, or any trading permission.

milestones.purpose: Freeze enums, chronology, parent-child authority, action priority, failure behavior, synthetic causality cases and prohibited shortcuts before any new data outcome access.
milestones.falsification: Any synthetic case permits unclosed/future/revised data, contradictory action priority, stop widening, parent override, or non-exclusive structural regime.

hypotheses.claim: A causal 4h parent StructuralRegime used only as a countertrend RSI reversal veto improves bounded opportunity utility relative to the frozen champion without creating continuation orders.
hypotheses.falsification: No stable incremental benefit after costs and block bootstrap, abstention opportunity cost exceeds tail-risk improvement, causal measurement failure, or any continuation order is created.

hypotheses.claim: Frozen adjacent parent-child relations improve calibration or bounded utility of permitted reversal evaluation relative to parent-only state, without child override of parent risk veto.
hypotheses.falsification: No incremental calibration/utility, child overwrites parent veto, relation is noncausal, or support is insufficient.

hypotheses.claim: A frozen CurrentPressureContext field family confirms or vetoes an already permitted L2 reversal candidate more safely than the same L2 candidate without L1 confirmation; it never creates standalone direction.
hypotheses.falsification: Any required L1 family is imputed as neutral, no incremental bounded utility/calibration after cost and latency, standalone direction is created, or branch support is insufficient.

hypotheses.claim: A frozen causal structural zone plus predeclared response classification adds value over a simple causal prior-high/prior-low level for permitted reversal evaluation.
hypotheses.falsification: Post-outcome zone, no increment over comparator, effect disappears under random/shifted-zone placebo, or a level is hand drawn.

hypotheses.claim: Frozen volatility/liquidity geometry for EntryZone, stop distance, horizon and capacity is safer or more stable than fixed-bps geometry under identical hard-risk limits.
hypotheses.falsification: Cost-after utility and tail risk do not improve, finite candidate neighborhood collapses, required L1 field missingness is treated as neutral, or depth is treated as guaranteed fill.

hypotheses.claim: Within an identical submission/fill cohort, a frozen one-way-risk remaining-EV exit policy improves bounded cost-after utility without worsening expected shortfall.
hypotheses.falsification: Changed entry/fill cohort, stop widening, horizon extension, tail worsening, no incremental utility, or intrabar path assumption is required.

hypotheses.claim: Past-only, embargoed analog episodes add calibrated incremental information beyond a no-analog baseline for the same eligible candidate set.
hypotheses.falsification: Future/overlap/outcome-selected neighbor, no incremental calibration or utility, unstable effect, or insufficient isolated historical support.

hypotheses.claim: Point-in-time macro event risk states reduce harmful exposure or improve calibration relative to the same eligible candidate set without a macro risk gate, without using revised values as past inputs.
hypotheses.falsification: Vintage leakage, publication-time ambiguity, no incremental bounded benefit, excessive opportunity cost, or directional narrative substitutes for observed fields.

hypotheses.claim: Only independently supported layer components jointly improve bounded utility and calibration on wholly new chronology relative to the strongest predeclared lower-complexity comparator.
hypotheses.falsification: Any unsupported predecessor, reused chronology, comparator replacement after results, complexity without incremental value, worse tail behavior, or holdout failure.

hypotheses.claim: A frozen D2/D3 point-in-time daily OHLCV prefix adds calibrated information about subsequent 1-3 day UPWARD_EXPANSION price outcome over a simple OHLCV shock baseline and time/regime-matched controls, without treating institutional intent, sentiment or news narratives as facts.
hypotheses.prefix_anchor_protocol: At D2/D3 close/available_at, freeze only the observed prefix state/probability/action; reveal 1-3 day price outcome only after availability. Full D1..D8 can never filter early-prefix samples.
hypotheses.cluster_rule: Nested prefixes are one episode cluster for split, bootstrap and multiple-comparison accounting.
hypotheses.falsification: Any full-episode selection for the early prefix, future/new-high lookahead, retrospective state rewrite, no increment over the single comparator family, effect disappears under time/regime controls, or event expansion creates an automatic order.

hypotheses.claim: A frozen D6/D7 failed-continuation prefix adds calibrated information about next-day DOWNSIDE/BREAKDOWN price outcome over a simple OHLCV shock baseline and time/regime-matched controls.
hypotheses.falsification: Any full-episode selection for the prefix, future/new-low lookahead, retrospective state rewrite, no increment over comparator, or automatic short creation.

hypotheses.claim: Point-in-time event arrival association may be described only as an independent diagnostic after the full event_visibility_invariant holds; it cannot make H10/H11 price outcomes pass.
hypotheses.falsification: Using an event source_timestamp, published_at or available_at before it is visible at decision_time, outcome-selected events, event association treated as price alpha, or no association relative to comparator.
